title: Shared UI Kit (ui/Button)
prompt:
Pull primitive components into a `ui/` folder so feature code can compose them without copy/pasting styles or markup.

**Requirements:**
1. In `ui/Button.tsx`, import `ButtonHTMLAttributes` from `react`.
2. Define `type ButtonProps = ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: 'primary' | 'ghost' };`.
3. Export `function Button({ variant = 'primary', ...rest }: ButtonProps)` that renders `<button data-variant={variant} {...rest} />`.
4. In `ui/index.ts`, re-export `Button` so callers do `import { Button } from '@/ui'`.

files.content:
export { Button } from './Button';
export type { ButtonProps } from './Button';

hints: Spreading the rest of `ButtonHTMLAttributes` makes your `Button` a drop-in replacement for the native element.
`variant` is the only design-system-specific prop -- forward everything else.
Co-locate the type with the component, then re-export both from the barrel.
